authorization: User explicitly requested completing D14/21/28, BDS by fold, and final reserved-test tables after configuration closure.
scope: Extension registered after inspection of the initial D7 development results. New CV is development/selection, not independent confirmation. Reserved-test scoring is authorized only after immutable configuration/model closure.
reuse_D7: Unchanged original primary relative_window ten-seed CV predictions/configurations, identified by source hashes.

training.refit: Fresh model on full permitted monthly training cohort, including already observed past2024; fixed selected inner epoch count; no warm start
training.batch_order: Deterministic generator seeded with stage seed+17; shuffled windows, chronology of sample construction remains intact

data_contract.target: sigma7(d)=population SD(ddof0) of daily log Close returns r[d-6:d+1], no annualization
data_contract.missing_days: Keep complete daily calendar; exclude incomplete days and all dependent windows, no imputation or bridging

calendar.final_fit_after_configuration_closure: development2023-2024, not performed by this CV runner

cv_policy.permitted_train_outcomes: u<=month_origin-D-1, growing history of 2023 and observed past2024
cv_policy.hyperparameter_search: No new family hyperparameter search; fixed widths/lr and budgets inherited, D is the explicit evaluated factor.

selection_policy.primary_metric: mean across ten seeds of annual pooled-date RMSE in CV2024
selection_policy.within_model: Choose D with minimum mean RMSE; numerical ties absolute tolerance1e-12 use smaller D, then parameters.
selection_policy.neural_baseline: Choose lowest mean CVRMSE among the twelve predeclared model/D settings; same tie rules, then model name lexicographic. Persistence reported separately as deterministic reference.
selection_policy.reserved_test: Report all twelve settings, but never select D, epochs, or baseline using their test metrics.

final_fit_policy.data: Development2023-2024 only, eligible labels u<=2025-01-01 index-D-1; retain D-day purge before test origin.
final_fit_policy.epochs: Per model/D/seed reuse the selected best_epoch of the December2024 inner CV fit, fixed before test.
final_fit_policy.seed: base seed4101..4110 supplied to helper; final refit initialization=seed+10000000, shuffle=stage seed+17
final_fit_policy.preprocessing: Fit relative-window channel scales and positive target mean only on permitted development training windows.
final_fit_policy.weights: Fresh refit per job; write configuration/checkpoint/scaler hashes before raw-test access; no test-period refits or adaptation.

test_policy.excluded: September-October2026 remain unassigned and must not be opened.
test_policy.gate: Require immutable freeze.json plus hashed final_models_manifest.json before opening any raw test ZIP or score.
test_policy.cohort: Predefined common eligible intersection across all four D, finite sigma7 and known persistence; retain full per-D eligibility/reasons and coverage, never select dates by errors.
test_policy.causal_scoring: One inference pass per saved final checkpoint; daily windows may use already observed test-period OHLCV from strictly earlier days. No test labels enter preprocessing/training/selection.
test_policy.monthly_reports: Twenty chronological reporting intervals of the same frozen final weights, not twenty retraining/CV folds.
test_policy.score_once: Resume from signed saved predictions; no test-driven tuning or reruns for performance.

analysis_plan.report: Per D/model/seed/month and pooled calendar; mean/sample SD and marginal t95CI across seeds conditional on evaluated dates. Monthly spread separately descriptive.
analysis_plan.MAPE: Only strictly positive true targets, no epsilon; report coverage.
analysis_plan.MASE: Historical lag1 scale fitted only on permitted training cohort; frozen final scale for test.

BDS.multiplicity: Holm within each entire predeclared phase family, maintaining undefined entries with status.
BDS.mean_p: Mean/SD of p-values are descriptive summaries, not combined tests or evidence of independence.
BDS.small_samples: Monthly n28-31: asymptotic, exploratory diagnostics; explicitly report finite-size/stationarity limitations and undefined/degenerate cases.

analysis_plan.persistence: Deterministic reference, no duplicate fits or seed uncertainty. Its sigma7 lag needs eight past closes, explicitly disclosed.

statistical_limits: Previously exposed development; no claim of a prospective pre-training pilot.
No test-driven hyperparameter or D selection.
Seed-conditional intervals do not establish population-wide generalization or equivalence.
BDS departure from iid does not uniquely identify nonlinear exploitable structure.
retention: Original signed scripts/results unchanged. Store all new folds, training configurations/scalers/curves/checkpoints/predictions/metrics; package per-run artifacts separately with SHA256 manifests.
